description:
I met my unforgettable first love again after ten years. And as the partner in an arranged marriage I desperately wanted to avoid!

The moment Ji-an saw him again, she realized... She thought she had run far away, but in the end, she had gone nowhere. If she could never escape, she decided to at least keep him in her sight. 

At Ji-an’s fearless words, "A marriage like this is fine," Do-jin stepped closer and warned her in a low voice: "Can you really do this with me?"

As he closed the distance, so much that she could feel his breath, Ji-an did not look away and firmly replied: "I can. I'm an actress."

After that passionate first kiss, Do-jin became a different person, charging toward her like a bulldozer. But the wounds and misunderstandings built up over time stood between them.
